{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders: revenue_clean == 999999.99
qa_mask = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99

# Filter out QA orders
df_filtered = df[~qa_mask]

# Now count completed orders in the filtered data
completed_count = df_filtered['status'].eq('completed').sum()

# Verify total count
total_filtered = len(df_filtered)
refunded_count = df_filtered['status'].eq('refunded').sum()

# Print final verification
print(f"Completed orders (excluding QA): {completed_count}")
print(f"Refunded orders (excluding QA): {refunded_count}")
print(f"Total orders (excluding QA): {total_filtered}")

# Confirm no QA orders remain
print(f"QA orders remaining? {qa_mask.sum() == 0}")"}
